name: fullstack-agent-installer
summary: Installs four modular AI assistant components (Memory, Voice, Visualizer, Bare Hands) using a single interactive installer CLI.
steps: Install Claude Code CLI on host machine
Clone installer repository from github.com/jaredrhod/fullstack-agent
Run setup script
Interactively select desired modules (ai-memory-vault, backtalk, ai-visualizer, barehands)
jarvis_use: Automate modular deployment and setup of assistant subsystems.

name: obsidian-plain-text-memory-vault
summary: Maintains long-term assistant context using plain-text Markdown files stored inside an Obsidian vault.
steps: Designate local folder as Obsidian vault directory
Load memory markdown files into LLM context at session startup
Append interaction logs, decisions, and context updates to text files during operation
jarvis_use: Maintain persistent session memory across agent restarts without complex database infrastructure.

name: circuit-board-hud-visualizer
summary: Displays real-time agent operational status using animated visualizer states and scrambled character text.
steps: Render circuit board visualizer overlay window
Display LISTENING state with animated audio waveform when receiving input
Display THINKING state with rapidly scrambling code characters during reasoning/tool execution
Display SPEAKING state with glowing circuit graphics during voice response
jarvis_use: Provide immediate visual feedback to user regarding assistant execution state.

name: backtalk-push-to-talk-voice
summary: Provides low-latency speech-to-speech interaction via Claude SDK using a push-to-talk key mapping.
steps: Hold designated hotkey to capture user microphone audio
Release hotkey to finalize audio input payload
Process request using Claude SDK engine
Output synthesized audio response within one second
jarvis_use: Enable hands-free, natural voice interaction with fast response latency.

name: barehands-webcam-gesture-tracking
summary: Tracks hand gestures via standard webcam feed to control floating screen overlays without VR hardware.
steps: Activate webcam gesture tracking HUD window
Capture video feed from standard camera without specialized sensors or gloves
Overlay visual tracking indicator rings anchored to detected hand positions
jarvis_use: Provide spatial desktop UI interaction without specialized hardware.

name: barehands-spatial-pinch-zoom
summary: Resizes floating spatial visualizer overlays and menus using double-pinch hand gestures.
steps: Perform pinch gesture with both hands on active screen element
Expand distance between hands to enlarge target overlay
Contract distance between hands to scale down overlay
jarvis_use: Dynamically adjust spatial UI panel scale using webcam gesture input.

name: barehands-3d-spatial-rotation
summary: Rotates visualizer components and document windows along 3D spatial axes using hold-and-pivot gestures.
steps: Engage grip gesture on visualizer ring or document window
Pivot hand in 3D space to rotate element along X/Y/Z pitch and roll angles
Release grip to anchor element in target orientation
jarvis_use: Tilt and orient spatial panels or document views in 3D space.

name: barehands-radial-node-menu-navigation
summary: Navigates local filesystem directories using floating radial node buttons and glassmorphism list menus.
steps: Tap central spatial HUD button to spawn radial nodes (VAULT, PROPS, WIDGETS)
Select category node to open translucent glassmorphic file menu panel
Scroll menu items and tap folder to inspect local files
jarvis_use: Browse local system files visually within spatial interface.

name: barehands-3d-hologram-rendering
summary: Instantiates and renders interactive 3D model assets directly from local directory menus into spatial UI.
steps: Navigate to local asset directory via menu interface
Select 3D model asset file
Render interactive floating 3D graphic in spatial interface
Manipulate model orientation and scale via hand gestures
jarvis_use: Display interactive 3D spatial models and assets upon user request.

name: barehands-claw-target-acquisition
summary: Targets and pulls distant desktop UI elements into foreground focus using claw and fist gestures.
steps: Aim claw gesture at target screen element
Observe target element shake animation confirming lock-on
Close hand into a fist to grab locked element
Pull fist back toward user to bring object into active foreground focus
jarvis_use: Select and bring background spatial windows or elements into active user workspace.

name: claude-code-parallel-task-execution
summary: Executes file modifications, system commands, web searches, and parallel sub-agent tasks using Claude Code CLI engine.
steps: Receive complex user goal via voice or text input
Perform file management and command line execution
Execute background web searches if information is needed
Spawn parallel sub-agent instances to execute multiple sub-tasks simultaneously
jarvis_use: Delegate complex multi-step automated jobs and concurrent sub-tasks.

name: background-log-retrieval-feedback
summary: Manages latency during complex background log searches by transitioning HUD into a scrambling THINKING state.
steps: Receive query requesting historical accomplishment retrieval
Trigger local log search operation in background execution engine
Switch UI visualizer to scrambling character THINKING state during search delay
Synthesize and play voice summary upon retrieval completion
jarvis_use: Provide immediate visual indication when agent encounters execution latency due to background file/log searches.
